worldcombat.skill.round.summary: Attacks one enemy with a song and passes an echo to nearby allies. Allies using Round before the echo fades gain double power and a shorter wind-up. The sound passes through cover.
worldcombat.skill.round.use.0: Hand the refrain to the allies around you
worldcombat.skill.round.use.1: Answer a partner's refrain with a doubled verse
worldcombat.skill.round.use.2: Name a target through cover with sound
worldcombat.skill.round.description.0: Deals about %1$s sound-based special damage to one enemy. When carrying an echo, its doubled power is already included in the displayed damage.
worldcombat.skill.round.description.1: Passes an echo to other allies within %1$s blocks for %2$s. Answering while carrying it has doubled power and a four-tick wind-up; the answer consumes that echo and hands a fresh one to another ally, so the caster never renews its own.
worldcombat.skill.round.description.2: Song reach %1$s blocks; sound is not blocked by cover.
worldcombat.skill.round.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.round.growth.0: From level %1$s the verse rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.round.growth.1: From level %1$s the verse rises to %2$s and the refrain lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.round.growth.2: From level %1$s the verse rises to %2$s.
On: refrain radius ×1.35 and duration ×1.3 so allies pick it up more easily, but your own verse is ×0.94, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +3 ticks. Off: keep the song to yourself for more power.
worldcombat.skill.round.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the companion closes in before singing. Larger values let it start from further out.
worldcombat.skill.round.preference.ai.jo: On: when a nearby ally carries the refrain it prefers to sing and keep the round going. Off: it only prioritises when it has actually received the refrain itself, otherwise it sorts like an ordinary ranged attack.
worldcombat.skill.round.lead.on: Lead: echo radius ×1.35 and duration ×1.3, with song power ×0.94, two extra normal wind-up ticks and three extra cooldown ticks.
worldcombat.skill.round.lead.off: Solo: keeps normal power, wind-up and cooldown, with a smaller echo radius and shorter echo duration.
